name: Masking
description: The adversary is trying to mask his activities to hide the true meaning or prevention of leaving any trails.

subtechniques.name: Hide arguments
subtechniques.description: Arguments might be hidden to mask commands as other processes, for example Nmap as syslogd.

subtechniques.name: Hide files
subtechniques.description:
Files may be hidden in volatile memory locations, such as /dev/shm, hiding a directory from the ls command or using ASCII characters for filenames. 

24/11/2024, 12:43, merged with
Hide permanent files

subtechniques.name: Mask sounds
subtechniques.description: Masking sounds might be applied to mask one’s voice.

subtechniques.name: Spoofing
subtechniques.description: In the context of information security, and especially network security, a spoofing attack is a situation in which a person or program successfully identifies as another by falsifying data, to gain an illegitimate advantage
